title: Compose read-only and write permission packs
narrative: Fangore is building a host app that must not let agents write the filesystem by default. He starts with a read-only permission pack — the write tool is refused, which proves deny-by-default works. Later he composes that pack with a write pack into one reusable set, and the same tool succeeds. He uses this whenever an app needs reusable permission packs instead of copy-pasted grant lists.
implementation: Kind `grant_gate_write`. `AccessPolicy` / `CompoundPolicy` over `FsWrite` grants; `AccessControl` denies then allows after composition. Soft expects: first attempt denied, second allowed after compound policy.
